author: mark
text:
Gate closed: alignment audit for v0.3 layout migration

Sampled implementation against each spec area called out in the
gate. Everything coherent with ARCH/PRINCIPLES/TAXONOMY at
abfe713; no drift, no follow-up balls filed.

ARCH §2.2 conv-repo layout: src/template/mod.rs ROOT_WORKTREE
constant, scaffold lays control files at conv-repo root with .git
inside root/, lernie new auto-id under <harness-root>/conversations/
verified end-to-end.

ARCH §2.6 merge=ours: template writes .gitattributes pinning
goal.md, soul.md, summary/** at scaffold; merge driver registered
via git config. Confirmed via tests/merge_ours.rs and template
inspection.

ARCH §2.7 compaction: compactor writes summary/<NNN>.md (not the
v0.2 .agent/compactions/ path); compactor goal references the new
path verbatim.

ARCH §2.10 snapshot-before-call: src/prompt/dispatch/mod.rs commits
the request.json snapshot at line 127, runs the adapter at 132,
lands response.json as a follow-up commit at 152 — never amends.

ARCH §3.3 tool resolution: src/prompt/tool/spawn.rs resolve() does
<harness-root>/tools/lernie-tool-<name> → PATH → in-process
fallback. Adapter resolution mirrors at <harness-root>/adapters/
(landed in bl-66da's src/prompt/adapter.rs::resolve_binary).

ARCH §3.5 UI contract: lernie-ui-egui has fs_watcher + cli_outbound
+ git_tree modules; stateless renderer over filesystem state, no
third channel.

ARCH §4.1-§4.3 providers split: src/config/providers.rs (global,
providers + models), src/config/per_repo_providers.rs (per-repo,
roles only). Cross-validation in src/config/cross/roles_check.rs.

ARCH §4.2 capabilities extensibility: known_capabilities() seeds
the registry; collect_warnings issues warnings (not errors) on
unknown capability names, matching the extend-only contract.

ARCH §8 unmerged-branch metric: crates/lernie-ui-egui/src/git_tree/
cmd.rs queries `git branch --list --no-merged=main` directly — no
sidecar, matches PRINCIPLES.md single-source-of-truth.

TAXONOMY.md banned terms: grep across src/, crates/, template/,
docs/ for "invocation" returns only informal usages (CLI invocation,
model invocation, tool invocation, adapter invocation) plus
explicit historical mentions in ARCH §2.3 and §12 milestones. No
structural usage as a primitive — the term is retired in favor of
"conversation" per ARCH §2.1.
